transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
The clinic for this logistics job said my weight was too low to clear me. I don’t really see it that way—I look lean to me, like I’m ready to work and stay quick on my feet.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah. If I eat rice or bread, or anything greasy, I start thinking it’s going to sit on me right away. Then the next morning I’ll check the scale or tighten my belt, just to make sure I didn’t let myself go.
Do you believe you are currently underweight?
No, I don’t think I’m underweight. My sister and the doctor keep saying I’m in danger, but I think they’re making it bigger than it is. I’m just keeping myself light, sharp, and ready for work.
What is your current weight?
I don’t have a number for you right now. The job clinic said it was too low, but I see myself as lean and fit to work.
Are you deliberately eating less to keep your weight down?
Yeah. Most days it’s just black coffee, maybe a boiled egg or a little tuna. If I’m not moving freight that day, I figure I don’t need a real meal.
Have you lost a lot of weight recently?
I guess I must have, since the logistics clinic said my weight was too low to clear me. But I don’t see it as a lot—I just look lean, like I need to be to work and stay quick on my feet.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
I’m not sure what you mean by make myself. I don’t really have anything to tell you about that.
After you eat, do you ever make yourself vomit to keep from gaining weight?
I don’t know. I mean, I haven’t really thought of it that way.
After you eat, do you ever make yourself throw up?
I... I don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t thought about it in those terms.
Do you ever make yourself vomit to keep your weight down?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know what you want me to say about that.
Do you ever use laxatives to keep your weight down?
I’m not sure what you mean by laxatives. I don’t really know how to answer that.
Do you ever have times when you eat a very large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I eat, but not a really large amount all at once.
Have your menstrual periods stopped?
I’m a man, so I don’t have menstrual periods.
What is your height?
I’m about average height. The clinic was more concerned that my weight was too low, but I feel like I’m just lean and fit for the logistics work.
What do you weigh right now?
I don’t know the exact number right now. The clinic said it was too low to clear me for the logistics job, but I just see myself as lean—ready to work and quick on my feet.
When you look at your body, do you see yourself as fat?

I don’t know if I’d say fat exactly, but when I look at my stomach and waist, I feel like I need to be smaller, tighter. If I’m not, it feels like I’m not as disciplined as I used to be working on the warehouse floor.
Has a doctor told you that your weight is dangerously low for your height?
Yeah, the doctor and my sister both keep saying my weight is dangerous. I think they’re making it bigger than it is, though. I’m just trying to stay light and sharp for work.
Do you ever take water pills to lose weight?
I’m not sure what you mean by water pills. I don’t really know about that.
After you eat, do you ever intentionally throw up?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that after I eat. What exactly do you mean?
What is your height and weight?
I don’t have the exact numbers with me. The logistics clinic said my weight was too low to clear me, but I think I just look lean—ready to work and stay quick on my feet.
